previous_episode_state.title: The Memory Price
previous_episode_state.episode_goal: Establish the memory exchange and force Nia to choose a patient's life over certainty about the entity.
previous_episode_state.synopsis: Paramedic Nia Calder hears a dying commuter's final memory and discovers immortal archivist Rowan Vale within a century-old scene. Rowan warns that reviving the patient will erase his only memory of a faceless entity, so Nia records his testimony before choosing the rescue. The patient survives wearing an antique tag Rowan recognizes, but Rowan's memory vanishes and his journal creates a blank page bearing Nia's name.

character_states.name: Nia Calder
character_states.motivation: Save every life she can without letting her supernatural burden endanger others.

character_states.name: Rowan Vale
character_states.motivation: Preserve enough evidence of the memory-trading entity to stop it before his identity disappears.

character_states.name: Eli Mercer
character_states.motivation: Survive long enough to deliver an impossible warning.

previous_episode_state.final_scene_outcome: Eli survives, Rowan retains only Nia's recording, and the journal marks Nia on a blank page.
previous_episode_state.final_turning_point: The self-turning journal reveals Nia's name where a memory should be.
previous_episode_state.next_episode_question: Why has Rowan's supernatural journal created a blank page bearing Nia's name?
